title: Reveal Ribbon: contextual micro-lessons for rollouts & cost views
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: users land on rollout and cost dashboards and often miss key actions (pin model, enable canary, set budget alerts). Existing empty states and static help text are not contextual to the user’s current task or their role. Goal: design a lightweight, persistent but unobtrusive UI pattern — the 'Reveal Ribbon' — that surfaces short, actionable micro-lessons tied to the active panel (rollouts, cost views, dashboards). The Ribbon is anchored to the right edge of the console and contains progressive steps, code/snippet templates, and one-click actions (apply template, open rollout wizard, create budget alert). It should increase first-success rate for rollouts, reduce time-to-first-budget-alert, and improve cost-awareness without creating noise.
success_metrics: activation: user triggers first rollout action within 10 minutes of encountering Ribbon
time_to_budget_alert: median time from Ribbon reveal to creating first budget alert < 6m
NPS_education: +5 for users who saw Ribbon vs control
solution_overview: Pattern: Reveal Ribbon (compact tab -> expanded micro-card). Trigger rules: show on first visit to rollout or cost tab; auto-show when a cost anomaly is detected; reappear after new feature release. Content types: 1) Short steps (3-step checklist), 2) Live snippets (pre-filled rollout/config templates), 3) Quick toggles (enable canary, pin model variant, enable KV cache warm-up), 4) Educational tips (one-sentence cost impact + link to deep dive). Controls: snooze 24h, dismiss permanently, send feedback. Accessibility: keyboard focus trap when expanded, screen-reader labels for micro-lesson steps.
tradeoffs_and_considerations:
- Risk of cognitive overload if Ribbon surfaces too often; mitigation: adaptive throttling and persona targeting.
- Engineering cost: needs lightweight backend flags + events; propose incremental rollouts by workspace tier.
- Privacy/compliance: do not surface customer-specific billing figures in public tips; only link users to their own cost dashboards.
- Internationalization: copy should be short; provide hooks for translations in the content API.
components_and_states:
- Compact state: 40px tab with subtle badge for new items.
- Expanded state: 360x420 card with header (title, progress), body (steps/snippets), footer (primary CTA, secondary snooze/dismiss).
- Empty-state variant: if no recommended action, show 1-line explainer + template gallery link.
- Error state: show offline message and fallback to static help panel.
data_and_telemetry: Events to track: ribbon_shown, ribbon_expanded, ribbon_snippet_copied, ribbon_action_taken (rollout_start, budget_alert_created), ribbon_dismissed, ribbon_snoozed. Suggested labels: persona, workspace_tier, trigger_reason. Use these for A/B and SLO evaluation.
a_b_test_plan: Two variants: A (Ribbon with snippets + primary CTAs) and B (Ribbon with micro-lessons only, no one-click actions). Run on new workspaces and a 20% sample of returning users for 4 weeks. Primary metric: rollout_action_rate. Secondary: budget_alert_rate and dismiss_rate.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Ribbon appears on first visit and on cost anomaly triggers for targeted users. 2) Primary CTA executes the intended action (opens rollout modal or pre-fills budget alert) in <1s. 3) Ribbon telemetry fires for all defined events. 4) Design QA: matches Figma mock, keyboard accessible, translations render correctly. 5) PM signs off on copy and rollout gating.

2026-03-03 - Jordan Park: Frontend effort looks reasonable; primary cost is wiring snippet templating and telemetry. We should scope snippet copy to 3 templates first. Suggest breaking into front-end + backend sub-tasks.
2026-03-05 - Riley Chen (PM): Love the adaptive reveal rules. Request: add a low-friction onboarding variant for new orgs that prompts to run the 'starter rollout' template immediately.
2026-03-07 - Design critique notes (Priya Rao): - Reduce copy per step to 1 sentence. - Use progressive disclosure for advanced tips. - Ensure color token contrast meets AA for the badge.

2026-03-09 - Mei Tan (Research): Prototype tested with 8 participants (mix of platform/dev leads). Findings: Ribbon improved task completion in first session (6/8) but two participants found it distracting when working on unrelated pages. Recommendation: add workspace-level opt-out setting.

2026-03-11 - Luca Mendes: Implemented prototype and shared staging link. Noted a minor keyboard focus bug when closing expanded card; assigned to ENG-48212. Also added toggle to gate snippets by workspace tier.

2026-03-12 - Riley Chen: Copy approved for release candidate. Plan: start a 10% rollout to new orgs on 2026-03-18 and monitor ribbon_action_rate and dismiss_rate closely. Next steps: finalize translations and feature flags.
